text:
Anna: Heads-up — final marketplace launch timeline needs alignment with TitanCloud hardware PR. Can we confirm press windows? :wave:
Devin: We currently have Redwood launch penciled for Apr 15 (blog + landing + marketplace listing).
Priya: TitanCloud is pushing for Apr 14 embargo. That’s one day before ours.
Marco: If Titan goes 4/14, could we move to 4/16 to avoid overlap?
Anna: 4/16 is risky — Azure Marketplace scheduled maintenance on the 16th morning (per infra). Might affect listing propagation. :grimacing:
PressOps: We can target Apr 15 12:00pm PT for the joint announcement slot — gives Titan a 4/14 embargo and us 4/15 live. Need final assets by Apr 1.
LegalBot: Legal requires co-announcement copy + partner quote no later than Mar 30 for review. Also need confirmation of data residency statement for the listing.
Devin: Action items: Marco to get partner quote; Priya to draft landing + marketplace listing copy; Anna to coordinate embargo windows with Titan.
Marco: Got it — I'll ping Titan today and try to get two quote options (short/long). ETA 03/29.
Priya: Drafting landing hero and CTA. Quick question: do we include Titan SKU pricing on the landing or link to marketplace listing? Prefer link to keep pricing authoritative.
Anna: Link to marketplace listing is preferable. Add a prominent "Try on TitanCloud" CTA that routes to the MSP listing.
PressOps: Also request partner headshot + 1-line bio for the blog by 03/31. We’ll publish the blog at the same time as the announcement.
Devin: Staging preview will be available once Priya uploads assets — use this URL: https://staging.redwood.ai/marketplace/titancloud (internal).
DeployBot: Preview deployment succeeded — staging URL: https://staging.redwood.ai/marketplace/titancloud (build 2026.03.28-7).
Anna: Quick contingency: if Titan delays, we can still publish Redwood-hosted blog + marketplace listing on 4/15 and do a separate joint note later. Not ideal but ok.
LegalBot: Please make sure partner quote has opt-in for being used in press and blog.
Marco: Noted. I'll ask for an explicit line.
Priya: I'll push a first draft to the staging site by 03/30 and share the link here for feedback.
Devin: I'll block the admin calendar: Apr 14 embargo window, Apr 15 noon PT publish, fallback option Apr 16 evening.
Anna: Great — owners and deadlines: Marco (quote) 03/29, Priya (assets + draft) 03/30, Legal (sign-off) 03/31, PressOps (final schedule) 04/01.
Priya: tagging checklist: hero image, partner logo (svg), partner quote, FAQ blurb, CTA target URL, marketplace tile assets.
PressOps: I'll prep the embargo email template to press and partners after Legal ok's copy.
Anna: Thanks team. I'll message Titan after this thread and confirm the 4/14 embargo possibility. :thumbsup:
Marco: Ping me if you need help coordinating with their comms lead.
Anna: Will do — closing this thread once Titan confirms.
